question: What claim about the yoginīs must hold if they are described collectively as all innate, all family-born, and all door-guardians?
inference: A complete class of yoginīs is intended, defined by innate origin, family origin, and the function of guarding doors.
uncertainties: It is unclear whether these are three classes or three attributes of one class.
plain_english: All are innate, all are family-born, all are door-guardians.
